violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHRIMP PASTE AND RAW PORK PASTE STORED ABOVE RTE SAUCES AND COOKED EGG/CABBAGE MIXTURE IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: COOLER REARRANGED AND PIC RE-EDUCATED. PROVIDED CROSS CONTAMINATION DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED BOK CHOY ON THE COUNTER AT 82F (1HR). OBSERVED COOKED PURPLE YAM ON COUNTER AT 73F (2HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: BOK CHOY MOVED TO FREEZER. COOKED PURPLE YAM LABELED WITH TIME TO BE DISPOSED OF AT 2:30PM.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: OBSERVED NO CONSUMER ADVISORY FOR THE SOFT YOLK EGG ITEM ON THE MENU.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PROVIDED GUIDANCE ON CONSUMER ADVISORY IN MANDARIN. PLEASE ADD THE CONSUMER ADVISORY TO BOTH MENUS BY JUNE 16TH.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED CHEMICAL BOTTLE OF ALCOHOL NOT LABELED.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: PIC LABELED BOTTLE DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. Observed during inspection an employee brew and drink tea while standing over a work surface where dumpling were actively being made
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. PIC and EHS had employe emote the open drinking containers away from the work surfaces where it may contaminate food

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. Observed a can of aerosol spray “RAID” in the facility
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC disposed of the can of aerosol raid

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Live Animals Prohibited
violations.observation: Observed live animals on the premises of the establishment. Observed during the beginning of inspection that the PIC was holding a dog behind the counter, when asked by the EHS, PIC informed EHS that the dog belonged to another person and she was watching the dog for them. EHS asked that PIC remove the animal from the kitchen premises.
violations.corrective_action: Remove live animals from the premises. Live animals carry disease-causing organisms and can transmit pathogens to people through direct or indirect contamination of food and food-contact surfaces. PIC removed animal from premises, PIC proceeded to wash hands before returning too the facility, reviewed with EHS that animals are not allowed to be present in the facility.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device Used to Check Sanitizer Conc
violations.observation: The operator is not testing the chemical sanitizing solution to ensure proper concentration of the solution. PIC found sanitizer test kit later during inspection, test kit has not been used since it was acquired, still wrapped in factory packaging.
violations.corrective_action: The operator shall be monitoring the concentration of the sanitizing solution using a test kit or other device. PIC opened and used sanitizer test kit

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:cooked white radish 60f, cooked lotus root 60f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Discarded.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: raw shrimp thawing in basket on ground.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. Education provided and shrimp moved to WIC.
